body:
Ran ~/wotan-deploy.sh for real -- /var/www/wotan is writable by this user directly, no sudo needed. curl https://wotan.okemily.com/DEADWEIGHT/ -> 200, same for dist/main.js and dist/generated/dw_protocol.wasm. Remaining real gap: curl .../DEADWEIGHT/ws -> 404 -- sudo-queue/94-deadweight-wotan-ws-bridge.sh (nginx location + dw-ws-bridge.service) genuinely needs sudo this sandbox doesn't have, so the client can't actually reach a match server yet. Commits: DEADWEIGHT@55f238a, WOTAN@cfe3cf2.

⚓ ☃
title: wotan.okemily.com/DEADWEIGHT is genuinely live (static page, verified via curl against the real domain)
